$comment: AVO routing config — the single source of truth for which tool owns which job (Local vs Paid), the confidence-gated resolution ladder, and the setup-chosen transcription language. Read-only for now; wired to the runtime in a later feature. Labels are only 'local'/'paid' — Paid may be better but is never labelled that way.

plan.description: Plan & spec via GitHub Spec Kit (/speckit.* commands).

transcribe.description: Edit / transcribe / caption. faster-whisper language chosen at setup.

motion.description: Motion / animation. HyperFrames default, Remotion when justified.

memory.description: Cross-session memory. Optional; AVO runs without it.

sandbox.description: Agent sandbox. Optional; WSL-only on Windows.

cleanup.description: Post-render cleanup + learndown (reports space used vs freed).

translate.description: Translate transcript/metadata for target locales (BL-004). Not wired yet.

voice.description: Provider voice profile from approved masters (BL-003). Consent required. Not wired yet.

localize-deliver.description: Multi-locale delivery pack with optional multi-audio (BL-005). Not wired yet.

resolution.note: Final resolution is inferred from the raw files. Output above source resolution is not yet supported (backlog + sponsor CTA).

transcribe.description: faster-whisper size; override via setup --model or avo.project transcription.model

understand.description: watch-skill / THE LOOP LLM tier (advisory; agent configures watch-skill)
